sample_unit: HeartShare participants (plus 59,705 ECGs from 12,338 WFBH patients in a secondary analysis)
models_evaluated: ECG-AI model for HFpEF detection (12-lead and lead I only)
unlisted_practices: Testing single-lead ECG input as a substitute for 12-lead input
Assessing within-patient reproducibility of AI output across serial ECGs
Assessing early preclinical detection of disease years before diagnosis

screen.reason: The study conducts external validation and retrospective longitudinal reproducibility analysis of an ECG-AI model for detecting HFpEF on multi-center and real-world EHR datasets, but does not test a specific clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
